notes.title: News about Furi Demake
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Furi Demake has been available for free for a little over a year now, and we truly loved watching you enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23727865/56f58dce3d74585874e985049dc4f0f00e8a96ae.gif[/img]

The game has not been getting a lot of visibility since its launch, and we want as many players as possible to get the chance to play it. Unfortunately a free game can only enter a limited amount of fests or events on Steam. Making it paid will allow us to register it in events, discount it, and make it visible to more people.

It will also help us measure how much interest this take on Furi is generating, as of course we are dreaming about adding more bosses to it. As we dream about it, which boss would you chose to be the next one to come to Furi Demake?

So on June 23rd we will make Furi Demake paid. But YOU can still grab it for free and keep it forever, and tell a friend to grab it! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593450/Furi_Demake__The_Chain/

Furi Demake is a loveletter to our community, and we thank you all for your support and we hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: It's time to climb in Cairn's demo!
notes.notes:
Hi there, 

You know how they say good things come to those who wait? Well, thank you for your patience, but wait no more: go and play Cairn's demo right now 🧗

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170150/Cairn_Demo/

In the demo, you play as Aava, attempting your first ascent before heading to mount Kami. After a warm-up in the climbing gym, you climb to the summit of mount Tenzen. You have full freedom to explore the small mountain ridge, learn how to climb, forage, and survive in a low-pressure environment. It packs many of the features of the full game.

To mark the occasion, we premiered a brand new gameplay trailer, check it out:

[previewyoutube=Q4In8-k2A-I;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Introducing Cairn
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

It is finally time for us to let you in on what we've been cooking: our next game Cairn, a mountain ascent adventure with an intuitive climbing simulation. 

Read the whole description here - also see the superstars who have joined our team to make this game! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588550/Cairn/

We have created a new climbing simulation that gives you complete freedom to explore the mountain, read the rock face and decide on your route. Climbing is challenging, with difficult sections to navigate, and you will need to use your equipment and pitons wisely. Cairn’s story mode will take you on Aava’s journey, as she sets to conquer a summit no one has  reached before, and you will decide what she’s ready to sacrifice to achieve the ascent.

[previewyoutube=nhyMWuORSuA;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll share more with you soon, but in the meantime [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588550/Cairn/]wishlist Cairn[/url] and stay tuned by: 
[list]
[*] Joining us on [url=http://discord.gg/thegamebakers]Discord[/url]
[*] Joining our (very occasional) [url=https://bit.ly/NewsletterTGB]newsletter.[/url] 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771276/6d60c64cf78b1f2fcd7b371b9fdcecf1b1a41ec1.jpg[/img]
After years of secrecy, it feels really good for the whole team to finally be sharing this with you, and we can’t wait to hear your feedback - and show you more!

Until then,
The Game Bakers

notes.title: Furi Fan art contest winners!
notes.notes:
Hi Furists, 

Thank you so much for taking part in this community week and sending your submissions for our fanart contest. Our theme this week was : Furi in different gaming eras. 

We received many incredible pieces, and it was really hard to choose only four to award. There was some truly impressive pixel art, incredible color mastery and even some mixed media art!

We brought in the whole studio to help decide on the winners, and it ended up being a very tight race among our three winners and our coup de coeur. Without further ado, here are our winners!

1st Place - Furi Stage 01 by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198091475304/]Lad[/url]

notes.title: How fast can you beat The Chain?
notes.notes:
Hi Furists, 

We hope you’re enjoying Furi’s community week so far - and that you beat The Chain in Furi Demake, because we’re running a speedrun competition for Furi Demake! It’s purely a speed contest, but we’ll appreciate anyone doing it in style! 

The contest will run [b]until December 18[/b], and you can share a video of your best run using [b]#FuriDemakeSpeedrun[/b] on Twitter to enter the competition. 

We’re excited to see how fast you can beat the game, and what rank you’ll get!

The winner will receive the following prize: Furi original soundtrack on vinyl + artbook + t-shirt

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23727865/8e6b7f2cc0318cf80262284490f17b322f58f922.gif[/img]

notes.title: Furi Fan art Contest
notes.notes:
Hi Furists, 

For this community week, we’re hosting a new fan art contest! Since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593450/Furi_Demake__The_Chain/]Furi Demake - The Chain[/url] just launched, we wanted the theme to be tied to that. Furi Demake is an 8-bit reimagination of Furi’s first boss, so this contest’s theme is: [b]Furi in different gaming eras[/b]. 

We can't wait to see your take on that! Check the instructions below to submit your fanart.

[b]Here are the prizes for the winners:[/b]
[list]
[*] 1st: Furi artbook + original soundtrack on vinyl + t-shirt + poster Guardians
[*] 2nd: artbook + original soundtrack on  CD
[*] 3nd: original soundtrack on  CD + poster Guardians
[*] “Coup de coeur”: original soundtrack on  CD + poster Guardians
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23727865/04b40f78b5e707366dc5b6d11643953ab40ab941.jpg[/img]

The fan art can be made with any medium, but must be created specifically for the contest and submitted by its creator. To participate, please send your fan art, your nickname, your social media profile and the name of your art to fanart@thegamebakers.com. 
We’ll need your entry [b]before December 15[/b].

Feel free to also share your work on social media with #furifanartcontest or in our [community hub](https://steamcommunity.com/app/423230?snr=2_9_100003_)! Be sure to email us too though, entries on social media only won’t count for the contest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23727865/ea2dc9aa8be17d5b17225b8592c90862b05b80b2.jpg[/img]
Furi Fan Art by Esidisi-86 one of last community week’s winners.

notes.title: Furi Demake - The Chain, out now!
notes.notes:
Hi Furists, 

We have a gift for you today: we’re launching a new game, inspired by Furi, and it’s entirely free! It’s an 8-bit-inspired version of The Chain’s boss fight, with frantic controls, fast-paced combat and mix of melee and ranged combat. In good old 8-bit pixel art and music from the 90s!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23727865/8e6b7f2cc0318cf80262284490f17b322f58f922.gif[/img]

To make this game come true, we’re partnered with Sylph, a solo dev specializing in 8-bit games. It’s been a passion project for the past few months, and we wanted to make this Demake completely free to thank you for your amazing support since the launch of Furi. 

Ready to dive into some intense and fast Furi-inspired gameplay with retro controls and style?

[previewyoutube=w9nTiXyKGhQ;full][/previewyoutube]
And to celebrate, we’ll be hosting a week-long community celebration, from now until December 6th. 
This week’s activities will include a dev stream with an all-star cast from the dev team, Furi’s creative director fighting The Strap in Furi, a fan art contest, a Furi Demake speedrun competition, merch discounts, and surprises that will be posted here and on our social media during the week.

That’s not all! Furi and its [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1802170/Furi__Onnamusha/]DLC Onnamusha[/url] are discounted the whole week - let your friends know they can get them at a low price and try out the demake.

Participate and stay posted with our news by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/thegamebakers]Discord[/url] or signing up for our very occasional [url=https://bit.ly/NewsletterTGB]newsletter from The Bakery[/url].
